data.name: Devajyoti
data.gender_notes: Devajyoti is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devajyoti is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words Deva (God) and Jyoti (Light). The name signifies 'God's Light' or 'Divine Light'. In Hindu mythology, the Gods are believed to be the source of light, wisdom, and truth. Devajyoti is thus a powerful name, bestowed with divine blessings and virtues. The name Devajyoti carries the meaning “God's Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devajyoti usually hope their child will grow to embody god's light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bringing light and wisdom into the world.
data.etymology: Devajyoti belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devajyoti total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Devajyoti is deeply rooted in Hindu culture, representing the belief in the divine and the supernatural. It reflects the Hindu spiritual tradition that places great importance on the connection between God and the individual. The name serves as a constant reminder of the presence of God in our lives and the importance of seeking divine guidance and protection.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Devajyoti holds great spiritual significance in Hinduism. It symbolizes enlightenment and divine guidance. By carrying this name, one is believed to be blessed with the light of knowledge, truth, and wisdom, leading them closer to their spiritual goals and inner peace. It also signifies the purity and holiness of the soul, as one who bears this name is seen as a vessel of divine light. Overall, Devajyoti is a name that encapsulates the essence of Hindu spirituality, encouraging one to live a virtuous and god-centered life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Devajyoti: God's radiance or Divine illumination. The name Devajyoti symbolizes the inner light of the soul that is born of the divine. It is the awakened consciousness that shines brightly, illuminating the path towards spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: Devajyoti is a traditional Hindu name, derived from 'Deva' (god) and 'Jyoti' (light). It is believed to have originated in ancient India, around 1500 BCE to 500 BCE during the Vedic period. The name was given to a child born during auspicious occasions, symbolizing the presence of a celestial being in the family.

Devajyoti is also mentioned in the Hindu epic, 'Mahabharata', as the name of a divine messenger sent by Lord Indra to the Pandava prince Bhima. This suggests the name's association with divine beings and their messengers in Hindu mythology.
